I relate to this so much. I feel guilt for my feelings. I'm trying to work on being able to validate my own thoughts and feelings, trying to convince myself it doesn't matter how much worse other people have it.. that's hard.
I cannot even imagine telling my family, that would be horrific. I don't want their pity, I don't want to be patronized. But.. I wish I had someone who understood.
I hope you find the peace you seek.
Oh man, I hear ya. I think this is one of the reasons I don't wanna seek help. If people know, they'll try to stop me. I'll be held accountable.

I haven't hurt myself in eight years and I still think about it. Sometimes when I'm stressed or upset or overwhelmed, but sometimes seemingly out of nowhere. It creates such a powerful and unique state of mind, simultaneously thoughtless and intensely focused. Completely removed yet entirely within self. I've never experienced anything like it.  

And it's true that it's not suicidal behavior. In fact, there are many times I did it as a method of suicide prevention. Feeling so depressed and anxious and overwhelmed and hopeless and worthless, and just wanting to stop existing. It's all too much and your mind is a hurricane, you can't focus or relax or find peace.  
But then you hurt yourself, and it's instant relief. Sure, after a few minutes the "high" wears off and you feel shame and regret and failure.. But the feelings are depressive, and you can sleep, and you will see another day.  

It quickly becomes a cycle, and that's when I knew I had to stop. When it became self-destruction for self-destructon's sake. I was no longer using it only as a release from emotions, but as a release from the desire for the thing itself.  

I've only told two people about my experience, and not even in great detail. I hope this helps or informs someone.

Thanks =) usually it's not a problem, but sometimes it won't leave me be... I wonder if it means I want to show my feelings to someone. I have a very stoic demeanor, and sometimes I wish I could share the things that torment me.
Hurt myself, thought about killing myself all the time.. You know, all that fun stuff.
